blurb: R&B Brewing has been brewing high quality, hand-crafted ales and lagers since 1997 in East Vancouver's Brewery Creek district. Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed in-house and artisan pizzas, sandwiches, salads, and snacks made by their in-house chef. The brewery offers a cozy tasting room, private rooms for events, and a welcoming environment for all ages including kids and dogs on the patio.
